title: Converging Smith Bench Press
summary: A Smith bench press on a machine whose rails angle inward, so the bar travels up and slightly toward your face like a free bench, with a bit more chest focus.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine); weight plates.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.55 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.55 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.45 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.45 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Lie on the bench so the bar lines up with your mid-chest at the bottom.
Unrack, then lower under control to your chest.
Press up along the angled path to straight arms.

form_cues.cue: Press up and in along the arc
Set the safeties just above your chest before you start.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Independent arm levers, Lower loading potential.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less stable, Lower loading potential.
